name: hpc-agent-antigravity
description: Standalone HPC Orchestrator Plugin: Cloud HPC Toolkit provisioning, VM availability & quota checks, Nextflow Batch optimization, 2 30-day monitoring skills with GUI dashboards (HPC/Slurm/Storage & Google Cloud Batch), and an every-4-hour HPC Spend & Monthly Budget Monitor UI Sidecar with automatic agent alerts.
suggestedPrompts: Open the HPC Spend Monitor (4h) sidecar to check our monthly HPC spend portion and set our monthly max budget
Run the HPC Cluster & Slurm Monitor skill to review our 30-day running instances, Slurm user jobs, and storage usage
Run the Google Cloud Batch Monitor skill to check active Batch nodes in use and per-user job durations over the last 30 days
